notes: Pin 2 goes by the blue wire to breadboard column 6 (bank b, strip with button side 1). The black wire joins Leonardo GND to column 4 (bank t, strip with button side 2). Pressing the button joins pin 2 to GND. There is no external resistor because the sketch uses INPUT_PULLUP.

The button straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6, with side 1 (1.l, 1.r) in bank b and side 2 (2.l, 2.r) in bank t. The image labels rows j-f above the gap and a-e below it, while the catalogue puts a-e in bank t and f-j in bank b. I used the catalogue naming, with hole positions read from the image.
The image shows the black wire going to the first GND pin next to 5V on the power header, which I mapped to GND.1.
